topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Oh my gosh, I can't believe you found your old teddy bear, of all things, at a yard sale! That's the bear you used to tell all your secrets to, remember? The one that went everywhere with you, even on those crazy bike rides where you always ended up with scrapes and bruises. It's like stepping back in time, you know? But do you think it's a good idea to bring it back? What if... what if things change because of it? Maybe it's best to leave some memories just as they are, safe and untouched. I mean, it's totally up to you, but just, tread carefully, okay? I'm here no matter what, just want you to think it through, that's all.
